text: Retrieve account and routing numbers for a user's demand deposit accounts (Instant Account Verification)
quote: With Instant Account Verification, you can connect to an end user's financial institution and retrieve account and routing numbers for their demand deposit accounts.

text: Retrieve account holder name and address from a linked financial account (Account Owner Identification)
quote: With Account Owner Identification, you can connect to an end user's financial account to retrieve information such as their name and address.

text: Verify account ownership via two small ACH microdeposits as an alternate verification method
quote: Verify account details by making two, small ACH deposits for end user confirmation

text: Retrieve real-time available balance for a connected financial account
quote: Get the available balance for an end user's financial accounts

text: Connect to institutions and retrieve 90 days of account and transaction data (Account Aggregation)
quote: With Account Aggregation, connect to end users' financial institutions and retrieve 90 days of data for their accounts and transactions.

text: Retrieve up to 24 months of account and transaction history (Extended Transaction History)
quote: With Extended Transaction History, you can connect to an end user's financial institution and retrieve up to 24 months of data for their accounts and transactions.

text: Webhooks send HTTPS POST callbacks so apps can subscribe to account/data events
quote: MX provides webhooks that send HTTPS POST callback requests to the URL of your choice.

text: Sandbox provides four test institutions for development and testing
quote: We offer four test institutions that you can use

text: Ready-made Connect Widget UI can be embedded to let end users link their bank accounts
quote: MX's ready-made UI that can be embedded in your application to aggregate users' account data by prompting end users to connect to their financial institutions using their credentials

text: Provides monthly account statements in PDF format
quote: Get monthly account statements in PDF format

text: Can share held account data with an FDX open finance platform
quote: Share your held data with an FDX open finance platform

text: Downloadable OpenAPI specification importable into Postman for exploring the API
quote: You can download our OpenAPI Specification and import it into Postman to learn more about our API and its request and response payloads.

text: Generates personalized financial guidance from each consumer's financial data
quote: Personalized financial guidance generated from each consumer's financial data, surfaced in a relevant and timely experience

text: Documents how to handle OAuth institution logins inside the Connect Widget when embedded in a WebView
quote: To test OAuth in the Connect Widget when it's embedded in a WebView, you must load the financial institution's OAuth window in the device's native browser and properly handle the results.

text: Issues Tokenized Account Numbers (TANs) as substitute account numbers for secure ACH money movement
quote: Tokenized Account Numbers (TANs) are substitute account numbers used for secure ACH money movement.

text: Automatically re-aggregates each connected member's data approximately every 24 hours
quote: MX automatically aggregates each `member` approximately every 24 hours.

text: Lets consumers ask about their money in plain language and get answers grounded in real permissioned data
quote: Provide an experience where consumers can ask about their money in plain language and act on the answer, with every figure pulled from real permissioned data.

text: Provides combined account and transaction history in one view to support multi-product adoption
quote: Access account and transaction history all in one view. Use the data to increase multi-product adoption, and build trust.
